No — as a Chinese passport holder you cannot get a visa on arrival (VOA). China is not on Vietnam's visa-free list, and Chinese nationals specifically are not eligible to use the VOA route.

What you should do instead: apply for an e-Visa at https://evisa.gov.vn/. It's open to all nationalities (including China) for stays up to 90 days, costs USD 25 (single-entry) or USD 50 (multiple-entry), and processing takes about 2-3 business days (faster/expedited options exist for a higher fee). It covers entry by air, land, or sea across 83 approved ports, so you're not restricted to one entry point — for your 10-day trip a single-entry e-Visa is enough.

One more requirement: your passport needs at least 180 days of validity remaining from your entry date.

This is based on skill data current as of 2026-08-17 — double-check the live policy at evisa.gov.vn before you travel.
